visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with long brown hair, wearing a brown zip-up jacket, sits on a grey sofa in a brightly lit room. She holds a large, thick stack of blue-tinted New Taiwan Dollar banknotes. She looks at the camera and speaks with active facial expressions, her hands steady as she fans the money. (2) The scene cuts to a close-up shot focused on the banknotes resting on a wooden table decorated with several camping-themed stickers. A pair of hands flips through the bills one by one, showcasing the sequential serial numbers printed in black ink. The holographic strips on the bills catch the light as they are moved. (3) The shot returns to the woman in a medium close-up as she continues her explanation. She gestures with her right hand while holding the stack of money in her left, emphasizing her points with smiles and direct eye contact. The background shows a neutral-toned wall and part of an indoor living space.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 連號鈔票的秘密 居然不會有這一個數字. [Subtitle]: 過年我們領了錢要發紅包. (2) [Subtitle]: 但是我們發現一個連號鈔票的小秘密哦. (3) [Subtitle]: 這一次呢 我們拿到的是4444. (4) [Subtitle]: 然後在01的連號鈔票. (5) [Subtitle]: 後來我這樣子數著 數著 數著. (6) [Subtitle]: 就我算到呢 444440 那0123. (7) [Subtitle]: 最後會 44444444 全部都是四嗎. (8) [Subtitle]: 給大家看哦 最後是. (9) [Subtitle]: 完全跳號的一個亂號的. (10) [Subtitle]: 下一號呢. (11) [Subtitle]: 又變成4445. (12) [Subtitle]: 哦 所以等於說呢. (13) [Subtitle]: 他避開了 444444 的這個號碼. (14) [Subtitle]: 他給你個亂數號碼. (15) [Subtitle]: 然後再來就接著 444. (16) [Subtitle]: 原來台灣人對不吉利的數字 還是很在意的. (17) [Subtitle]: 但我是不 在意啊 只要是錢就好 都給我好了 哈哈哈.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To share an interesting observation about Taiwan's central bank skipping the serial number '444444' on sequential banknotes due to the cultural superstition that the number four is unlucky.
